source.name: National Energy System Operator (NESO) Regional Carbon Intensity Forecast
source.licence: NESO Open Data Licence / API CC BY 4.0

window_utc.selection_rule: first complete Monday-Sunday ISO week of 2026

cloud-a5000-0.column: North West England Carbon Intensity Forecast

serverless-a5000-1.column: South East England Carbon Intensity Forecast

threshold_rule.critical: max over replay rows of the lowest regional intensity plus numerical epsilon; guarantees >=1 carbon-feasible resource at every replay step
threshold_rule.deferred: max over replay rows of the 3rd-lowest regional intensity plus numerical epsilon; guarantees >=3 carbon-feasible resources at every replay step
threshold_rule.flexible: maximum finite replay intensity plus numerical epsilon; guarantees all resources are carbon-feasible

iteration_mapping: Map optimizer iteration t in [0,T] linearly to replay row round(t*(K-1)/T).
missing_data_policy: Forward-fill within each selected region after the first observed value; back-fill only initial leading gaps from the first subsequent observed value. Fail if an entire selected region is missing.
